description: Put a cable, or a loose wire, through a cable gland on an enclosure wall (G2): gland "GL1", or null to take it out. One cable per gland; loose wires may share a gland but not with a cable. Set the cable's outer diameter with update_cable od_mm so validate_project can check it fits.

wire.description: A loose wire: its id from get_project, or "FROM:TERM -> TO:TERM"
